metadata.notes: Audit-and-replace of auto-seeded placeholder picks for all 30 Tamil Nadu destinations (kotagiri and vedanthangal have 3 slots each, all others 4; 118 total — matches baseline). TTDC Hotel Tamil Nadu network used as the authoritative government anchor; Tamil Nadu Forest Department eco-lodges for the tiger reserves (Topslip/Anamalai, Mudumalai, Point Calimere, Vedanthangal); CGH Earth, Neemrana and INDeco heritage hotels in the delta and Chettinad. ~77% of picks failed verification as keep_existing (46 replace + 45 honest_scarcity of 118). Notable fabrications/cross-dest catches: Crowne Plaza Chennai Adyar Park (closed 2023), Radisson Blu 'Kanchipuram' (Radisson is only at Mahabalipuram Temple Bay), Dakshin Chitra Heritage Stay (DakshinaChitra is a museum), GRT Hotels Thanjavur + GRT Nativity Chettinad (no such GRT properties), Thanjavur Palace Heritage Stay (ASI monument), The Bangala mis-slotted to Madurai (it is in Karaikudi), Somatheeram + Padmanabhapuram Palace at Kanyakumari (Somatheeram is in Kerala, Padmanabhapuram is a Kerala-govt museum), Bandipur Bamboo Retreat + Silent Valley at Mudumalai (Karnataka/Kerala cross-state), Orange County Yercaud (brand is Karnataka-only), Hotel Sakthi Park mislocated to Vedanthangal (it is in Melmaruvathur), Cauvery Delta Houseboat (no houseboats on the Cauvery). Honest-scarcity heavy at dhanushkodi (all 4 — protected ghost town, no accommodation), point-calimere/vedanthangal/anamalai (sanctuaries — forest-department lodges only), meghamalai (remote ghats — estate bungalows only), and the thin-stock temple towns (srirangam all 4 — most hotels are in Trichy proper, chidambaram, hogenakkal, courtallam).
